summary: Ichor Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) program to sell up to $200 million of its ordinary shares through agents TD Cowen, Stifel, Needham & Company, and Craig-Hallum. Shares trade on Nasdaq under ICHR; last price $73.27 as of May 15, 2026. Sales will be made at market prices via negotiated or block trades, with agent compensation up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or corporate event. What to watch: dilution from gradual share sales.
